IT FINALLY GOT A GOOD UPDATE
script:
-- this script has been generated by Gemini (3.1-pro), have fun!

--[[
	FE drop tools | by TerminatorDev
	Executor: Delta Optimized
	Bypass: Recursive Remote Discovery + Legacy Chat Fallback
--]]

-- 1. SERVICES
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ChatService = game:GetService("Chat")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- 2. PLAYER VARIABLES
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")

-- 3. STATE & CONFIG
local droppedTools = {} 
local inHitboxStatus = {} 
local playerRanks = {} -- Stores: "special", "admin", or nil
local stealingEnabled = false
local frameCounter = 0
local frameUpdate = 1 
local VOID_LEVEL = -100
local allowChatLogs = true

-- 4. THE BYPASS CHAT SENDER
local function characterChat(msg)
    if not allowChatLogs then return end
    task.spawn(function()
        local tcs = game:GetService("TextChatService")
        if tcs.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local channel = tcs:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral", true) or tcs:FindFirstChild("TextChannels", true):FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if channel then 
                channel:SendAsync(msg) 
                return
            end
        end

        local sayMsg = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest", true)
        if sayMsg and sayMsg:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            sayMsg:FireServer(msg, "All")
            return
        end

        if character and character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
            ChatService:Chat(character.Head, msg, Enum.ChatPrivacySetting.All)
        end
    end)
end

-- 5. NOTIFICATION HELPER
local function notify(title, desc)
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = title, Text = desc, Duration = 5})
    end)
end

-- 6. RECALL HELPER
local function recall(tool)
    local data = droppedTools[tool]
    if data and data.Part then data.Part:Destroy() end
    droppedTools[tool] = nil
    inHitboxStatus[tool] = nil
    tool.Grip = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
    
    task.spawn(function()
        tool.Parent = backpack
        task.wait()
        if character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then tool.Parent = character end
    end)
end

-- 7. COMMAND HANDLER (Universal for Ranks)
local function handleCommand(speaker, msg)
    local lowMsg = msg:lower()
    local args = lowMsg:split(" ")
    local rank = (speaker == player) and "special" or playerRanks[speaker]
    
    -- "None" rank check
    if not rank and lowMsg ~= "q" then return end

    -- /ineedhelp (All ranked)
    if lowMsg == "/ineedhelp" then
        characterChat("Chat commands: /stealtoolsfromme false/true, /equip {user}, /drop {user/all}, /frameupd {n}.")

    -- /rank (Special only)
    elseif args[1] == "/rank" and #args == 3 and rank == "special" then
        local targetName = args[2]
        local newRank = args[3]
        local targetPlayer = nil
        
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Name:lower():find(targetName) or p.DisplayName:lower():find(targetName) then
                targetPlayer = p
                break
            end
        end
        
        if targetPlayer and targetPlayer ~= player then
            if newRank == "admin" then
                playerRanks[targetPlayer] = "admin"
                characterChat(targetPlayer.DisplayName .. "'s rank has been set to ADMIN👑.")
            elseif newRank == "special" then
                playerRanks[targetPlayer] = "special"
                characterChat("INCREDIBLE! " .. targetPlayer.DisplayName .. " is so lucky, that it's rank has been set to SPECIAL⭐, congrats!")
            elseif newRank == "none" then
                playerRanks[targetPlayer] = nil
                characterChat(targetPlayer.DisplayName .. "'s rank has been set to NONE.")
            end
        end

    -- /frameupd (Admin/Special)
    elseif args[1] == "/frameupd" and #args == 2 then
        local num = tonumber(args[2])
        if num then frameUpdate = math.max(1, math.floor(num)) end

    -- /stealtoolsfromme (Admin/Special)
    elseif args[1] == "/stealtoolsfromme" and #args == 2 then
        if args[2] == "true" then stealingEnabled = true
        elseif args[2] == "false" then 
            stealingEnabled = false
            for t, d in pairs(droppedTools) do if d.Stealer then recall(t) end end
        end
        
    -- /equip (Admin/Special)
    elseif args[1] == "/equip" and #args == 2 then
        local targetName = args[2]
        local tool = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
        if tool and targetName then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= player and (p.Name:lower():find(targetName) or p.DisplayName:lower():find(targetName)) then
                    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
                    hitbox.Size = tool.Handle.Size; hitbox.Transparency = 1; hitbox.CanCollide = true
                    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -4)
                    hitbox.Parent = workspace
                    droppedTools[tool] = {Part = hitbox, Stealer = nil, DropTime = tick()}
                    inHitboxStatus[tool] = true 
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local limit = tick() + 10 
                        while droppedTools[tool] and droppedTools[tool].Stealer == nil and tick() < limit do
                            local tChar = p.Character
                            local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if tRoot then
                                hitbox.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame
                                if (hitbox.Position - tRoot.Position).Magnitude < 3.5 then
                                    droppedTools[tool].Stealer = p
                                    droppedTools[tool].DropTime = tick() + 999999
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                            task.wait()
                        end
                    end)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        
    -- /drop (Admin/Special)
    elseif args[1] == "/drop" and #args == 2 then
        local target = args[2]
        for tool, data in pairs(droppedTools) do
            if target == "all" or (data.Stealer and (data.Stealer.Name:lower():find(target) or data.Stealer.DisplayName:lower():find(target))) then
                recall(tool)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- 8. GLOBAL LISTENERS
local function setupPlayer(p)
    p.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
        handleCommand(p, msg)
        -- Global Q Listener
        if msg:lower() == "q" then
            for tool, data in pairs(droppedTools) do
                if data.Stealer == p then
                    local sChar = p.Character
                    local sRoot = sChar and sChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if sRoot then
                        data.Stealer = nil; data.DropTime = tick()
                        inHitboxStatus[tool] = true; data.Part.CFrame = sRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -5)
                        data.Part.CanCollide = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- 9. MAIN RUN LOGIC STAGED AFTER QUESTION
local function runMainScript()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do setupPlayer(p) end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)

    -- Startup Messages (Only fires if allowChatLogs is true)
    if allowChatLogs then
        characterChat("FE drop tools | by TerminatorDev")
        task.delay(2, function()
            characterChat("FOR PLAYERS! say Q on the chat to drop a fake tool.")
        end)
        notify("read me!", "if you need help accessing commands, type /ineedhelp on the chat.")
    end

    -- Drop GUI Base Setup
    local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)
    screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false 
    local dropBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", screenGui)
    dropBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 40)
    dropBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -50, 0.6, 0)
    dropBtn.Text = "Drop item"
    dropBtn.Draggable = true; dropBtn.Active = true

    dropBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        pcall(function()
            local tool = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
            if tool and not droppedTools[tool] then
                local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
                hitbox.Size = tool.Handle.Size; hitbox.Transparency = 1; hitbox.CanCollide = true
                hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -4)
                hitbox.Parent = workspace
                droppedTools[tool] = {Part = hitbox, Stealer = nil, DropTime = tick()}
                inHitboxStatus[tool] = true 
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- FLOATING ICON AND UI CREATION
    pcall(function()
        local uiContainer = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)
        uiContainer.Name = "FDT_UI_Container"
        uiContainer.ResetOnSpawn = false
        uiContainer.DisplayOrder = 9999

        -- Floating Icon Box
        local iconFrame = Instance.new("Frame", uiContainer)
        iconFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
        iconFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.2, 0)
        iconFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
        iconFrame.Active = true

        local iconCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", iconFrame)
        iconCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

        local iconGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient", iconFrame)
        iconGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255))
        })

        local iconInner = Instance.new("Frame", iconFrame)
        iconInner.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4)
        iconInner.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 2)
        iconInner.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
        
        local innerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", iconInner)
        innerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

        local iconBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", iconInner)
        iconBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        iconBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        iconBtn.Text = "FDT"
        iconBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
        iconBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        iconBtn.TextSize = 18

        -- Draggable functionality for Touch & Mouse
        local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
        iconFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = iconFrame.Position
                input.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
                end)
            end
        end)
        iconFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragInput = input
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input == dragInput and dragging then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                iconFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
            end
        end)

        -- Command Panel Frame
        local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", uiContainer)
        mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 360)
        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.5, -180)
        mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
        mainFrame.Visible = false
        mainFrame.Active = true

        local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", mainFrame)
        mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

        -- Draggable Panel
        local panelDragging, panelDragInput, panelDragStart, panelStartPos
        mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                panelDragging = true
                panelDragStart = input.Position
                panelStartPos = mainFrame.Position
                input.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then panelDragging = false end
                end)
            end
        end)
        mainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                panelDragInput = input
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input == panelDragInput and panelDragging then
                local delta = input.Position - panelDragStart
                mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(panelStartPos.X.Scale, panelStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X, panelStartPos.Y.Scale, panelStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
            end
        end)

        -- Header Title
        local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", mainFrame)
        titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 35)
        titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
        titleLabel.Text = "FE Drop Tools Control Panel"
        titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        titleLabel.TextSize = 16
        titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

        -- Close Panel Button
        local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", mainFrame)
        closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
        closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 2)
        closeBtn.Text = "X"
        closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 70, 70)
        closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        closeBtn.TextSize = 18
        closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() mainFrame.Visible = false end)

        iconBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            mainFrame.Visible = not mainFrame.Visible
        end)

        -- Content Scrolling Canvas
        local scrollCanvas = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", mainFrame)
        scrollCanvas.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -45)
        scrollCanvas.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40)
        scrollCanvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        scrollCanvas.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 480)
        scrollCanvas.ScrollBarThickness = 5

        local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", scrollCanvas)
        layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 12)
        layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

        -- Construction UI Items Helper
        local function addRowLayout(title, desc, canvas)
            local row = Instance.new("Frame", canvas)
            row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 85)
            row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
            
            local rowCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", row)
            rowCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

            local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
            label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 20)
            label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 4)
            label.Text = title
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
            label.TextSize = 14
            label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            label.BackgroundTransparency = 1

            local summary = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
            summary.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 28)
            summary.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 22)
            summary.Text = desc
            summary.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
            summary.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
            summary.TextSize = 12
            summary.TextWrapped = true
            summary.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            summary.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
            summary.BackgroundTransparency = 1

            return row
        end

        -- COMMAND 1: /drop
        local dropRow = addRowLayout("/drop | [username] [ALL PLAYERS]", "• immediately pick up tools from players.", scrollCanvas)
        
        local dropBox = Instance.new("TextBox", dropRow)
        dropBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0, 24)
        dropBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -30)
        dropBox.PlaceholderText = "Username target"
        dropBox.Text = ""
        dropBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
        dropBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        dropBox.TextSize = 12
        Instance.new("UICorner", dropBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

        local dropEnter = Instance.new("TextButton", dropRow)
        dropEnter.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, -5, 0, 24)
        dropEnter.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 2, 1, -30)
        dropEnter.Text = "Enter"
        dropEnter.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
        dropEnter.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        dropEnter.TextSize = 12
        Instance.new("UICorner", dropEnter).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        dropEnter.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if dropBox.Text ~= "" then handleCommand(player, "/drop " .. dropBox.Text) end
        end)

        local dropAllBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", dropRow)
        dropAllBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -5, 0, 24)
        dropAllBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 2, 1, -30)
        dropAllBtn.Text = "All"
        dropAllBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 110, 180)
        dropAllBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        dropAllBtn.TextSize = 12
        Instance.new("UICorner", dropAllBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        dropAllBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() handleCommand(player, "/drop all") end)

        -- COMMAND 2: /equip
        local equipRow = addRowLayout("/equip | [username]", "• Teleports tool hitbox directly onto player to equip it to them.", scrollCanvas)
        
        local equipBox = Instance.new("TextBox", equipRow)
        equipBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, -10, 0, 24)
        equipBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -30)
        equipBox.PlaceholderText = "Username target"
        equipBox.Text = ""
        equipBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
        equipBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        equipBox.TextSize = 12
        Instance.new("UICorner", equipBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

        local equipEnter = Instance.new("TextButton", equipRow)
        equipEnter.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -5, 0, 24)
        equipEnter.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 2, 1, -30)
        equipEnter.Text = "Enter"
        equipEnter.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
        equipEnter.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        equipEnter.TextSize = 12
        Instance.new("UICorner", equipEnter).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        equipEnter.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if equipBox.Text ~= "" then handleCommand(player, "/equip " .. equipBox.Text) end
        end)

        -- COMMAND 3: /stealtoolsfromme
        local stealRow = addRowLayout("/stealtoolsfromme | [TOGGLE]", "• Allows other players to walk up and take your dropped tools.", scrollCanvas)
        
        local stealOn = Instance.new("TextButton", stealRow)
        stealOn.Size = UDim2.new(0.45, -5, 0, 24)
        stealOn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -30)
        stealOn.Text = "ON"
        stealOn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 130, 50)
        stealOn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        stealOn.TextSize = 12
        Instance.new("UICorner", stealOn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        stealOn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() handleCommand(player, "/stealtoolsfromme true") end)

        local stealOff = Instance.new("TextButton", stealRow)
        stealOff.Size = UDim2.new(0.45, -5, 0, 24)
        stealOff.Position = UDim2.new(0.45, 8, 1, -30)
        stealOff.Text = "OFF"
        stealOff.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 50, 50)
        stealOff.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        stealOff.TextSize = 12
        Instance.new("UICorner", stealOff).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        stealOff.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() handleCommand(player, "/stealtoolsfromme false") end)

        -- COMMAND 4: /frameupd
        local frameRow = addRowLayout("/frameupd | [value]", "• Updates execution throttle rates. Minimum value is 1.", scrollCanvas)
        
        local frameBox = Instance.new("TextBox", frameRow)
        frameBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, -10, 0, 24)
        frameBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -30)
        frameBox.PlaceholderText = "Numerical rate (e.g. 1)"
        frameBox.Text = ""
        frameBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
        frameBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        frameBox.TextSize = 12
        Instance.new("UICorner", frameBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

        local frameEnter = Instance.new("TextButton", frameRow)
        frameEnter.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -5, 0, 24)
        frameEnter.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 2, 1, -30)
        frameEnter.Text = "Enter"
        frameEnter.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
        frameEnter.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        frameEnter.TextSize = 12
        Instance.new("UICorner", frameEnter).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        frameEnter.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if frameBox.Text ~= "" then handleCommand(player, "/frameupd " .. frameBox.Text) end
        end)

        -- COMMAND 5: /rank
        local rankRow = addRowLayout("/rank | [username] [rank]", "• Grant special or admin script privileges to specified target.", scrollCanvas)
        
        local rankTargetBox = Instance.new("TextBox", rankRow)
        rankTargetBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, -6, 0, 24)
        rankTargetBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -30)
        rankTargetBox.PlaceholderText = "User"
        rankTargetBox.Text = ""
        rankTargetBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
        rankTargetBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        rankTargetBox.TextSize = 11
        Instance.new("UICorner", rankTargetBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

        local rankTypeBox = Instance.new("TextBox", rankRow)
        rankTypeBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, -6, 0, 24)
        rankTypeBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.4, 6, 1, -30)
        rankTypeBox.PlaceholderText = "admin/none"
        rankTypeBox.Text = ""
        rankTypeBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
        rankTypeBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        rankTypeBox.TextSize = 11
        Instance.new("UICorner", rankTypeBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

        local rankEnter = Instance.new("TextButton", rankRow)
        rankEnter.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -4, 0, 24)
        rankEnter.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 4, 1, -30)
        rankEnter.Text = "Enter"
        rankEnter.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
        rankEnter.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        rankEnter.TextSize = 12
        Instance.new("UICorner", rankEnter).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        rankEnter.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if rankTargetBox.Text ~= "" and rankTypeBox.Text ~= "" then 
                handleCommand(player, "/rank " .. rankTargetBox.Text .. " " .. rankTypeBox.Text) 
            end
        end)

        -- Dynamic Rainbow Shift Logic loop
        task.spawn(function()
            local r = 0
            while task.wait(0.03) do
                r = r + 0.01
                if r > 1 then r = 0 end
                iconGradient.Rotation = r * 360
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- 10. MAIN PROCESS LOOP
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        local isLagPaused = (tick() % 51) >= 50

        local activeCount = 0
        for _ in pairs(droppedTools) do activeCount = activeCount + 1 end
        
        if activeCount == 0 then return end
        frameCounter = (frameCounter + 1) % (frameUpdate + activeCount)

        -- Process Dropped/Equipped Tools
        for tool, info in pairs(droppedTools) do
            pcall(function()
                local hitbox = info.Part
                local stealer = info.Stealer
                if hitbox.Position.Y < VOID_LEVEL then recall(tool) return end

                -- Drop on Death
                if stealer and stealer.Character then
                    local hum = stealer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                        info.Stealer = nil; info.DropTime = tick(); inHitboxStatus[tool] = true; hitbox.CanCollide = true
                        stealer = nil
                    end
                end

                local ownerDist = (rootPart.Position - hitbox.Position).Magnitude
                if inHitboxStatus[tool] and ownerDist > 5 then
                    task.delay(0.1, function() inHitboxStatus[tool] = false end)
                end

                if stealingEnabled and not stealer and (tick() - info.DropTime) > 1 then
                    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if p ~= player and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                            local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            if hum and hum.Health > 0 and (p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - hitbox.Position).Magnitude < 3.5 then
                                info.Stealer = p; break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                if not stealer and not inHitboxStatus[tool] and (tick() - info.DropTime) > 1 then
                    if ownerDist < 3.5 then recall(tool); return end
                end

                local hand = character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
                local attach = hand and (hand:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment") or hand)
                if attach then
                    local targetPos = hitbox.Position
                    if stealer and stealer.Character then
                        local sHand = stealer.Character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or stealer.Character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
                        if sHand then 
                            local offset = sHand.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -1)
                            targetPos = offset.Position; hitbox.CFrame = offset
                        end
                    end
                    local tRel = rootPart.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(targetPos)
                    local hRel = rootPart.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(attach.WorldPosition)
                    
                    -- STABILITY CALCULATION
                    local _, yOrientation, _ = rootPart.CFrame:ToOrientation()
                    local counterRotation = CFrame.Angles(0, yOrientation, 0)
                    local lookOrientation = CFrame.new(Vector3.zero, hitbox.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1))
                    
                    tool.Grip = counterRotation * lookOrientation * CFrame.new((tRel - hRel) * -1)
                end

                if not isLagPaused then
                    if frameCounter == 0 then tool.Parent = backpack; tool.Parent = character
                    elseif tool.Parent ~= character then tool.Parent = character end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    -- RE-INIT
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
        for tool, info in pairs(droppedTools) do if info.Part then info.Part:Destroy() end end
        table.clear(droppedTools); table.clear(inHitboxStatus)
        character = newChar; rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart"); backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
    end)
end
